# Vendored artifacts — license notice

The compiled bundles in this directory (`format-dist/`, `runtime-dist/`, `calc-dist/`,
and the `mcp-reference/` sources they are documented against) are build artifacts of the
private Origami Folio monorepo. They are the same bytes embedded in every saved

They are included here so the project builds and runs from a clone, and they may be used
and redistributed **as part of this project**. They are NOT covered by the repository's
AGPL-3.0 license, and their source is not published. Everything outside `vendor/` is
